pages.text: Late Phase 6 is vacuum. $(danger)Exposed flames go out.$()

pages.title: Needs Air
pages.text: $(li)Fire and campfires$(li)Torches and lanterns$(li)Candles$(li)MiteAway burners$(li)Fuel furnaces

pages.title: Seals
pages.text: Rooms seal and get oxygen by the same rules as your suit readout.$(br2)Full glass roofs seal. Open doors, open trapdoors and fences don't. Warmth is not air.

pages.title: Relighting
pages.text: Spent torches and dark lanterns stay put and drop their normal items. Relight with flint and steel in breathable air.$(br2)Campfires and candles relight normally. Furnaces keep their fuel and resume.

pages.title: Exceptions
pages.text: Soul fire, torches, lanterns and campfires keep burning but supply no oxygen.$(br2)Lava and powered or geothermal heat aren't flames.
